title: Conduvera GateEvidenceReference (release D8_GATE_PROTOCOL)
description: Typed, content-bound pointer to one immutable evidence artifact produced by a gate execution. The reference carries the subject binding and the canonical store location; the digest proves identity only after the referenced payload is resolved from its canonical store and re-hashed. Evidence references never carry decisions.

content_sha256.description: sha256 over the canonical content of the referenced evidence payload.

subject_ref.description: Exact digest or identifier of the subject this evidence is about.

store_location.description: Canonical, resolvable store location (URI or canonical store path); never a caller-supplied ad-hoc path.
